items.text: 3.9 Cash and cash equivalents Cash and cash equivalents comprise cash in hand and cash at banks. Cash and cash equivalents are carried at cost. 3.10 Revenue Revenue is measured at the fair value of the consideration received or receivable, net of returns allowances, trade discounts and rebates, and represents amounts received or receivable for goods and services provided and other operating income earned in the normal course of business. Revenue is recognized when it is probable that the economic benefits associated with the transaction will flow to the Modaraba, and the amount of revenue and the associated costs incurred or to be incurred can be measured reliably.
